2.69.11
Table.Left
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Table.Left element specifies the distance of a Table from the left of the table's container. This
element is optional. If this element is specified, its value MUST be a non-negative RdlSize. If the
Table.Left element is not specified, the value of this element is interpreted as 0.
Following is the parent element of the Table.Left element.
Parent elements
Table
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Table.Left element.
 <xsd:element name="Left" type="SizeType" minOccurs="0" />
